title: Great Big Beautiful Life by Emily Henry
description:
Novels and Nibbles follows an aspiring biographer, Alice Scott, and a brooding Pulitzer Prize winner, Hayden Anderson, who are invited to a secluded Georgia island to compete for a chance to write the life story of Margaret Ives, a mysterious, scandal-ridden heiress who has been missing from public view for years. As Margaret reveals her secrets, Alice and Hayden try to untangle what is true while dealing with their growing attraction to one another. It’s a little mystery, some romance, and how differently one life can be remembered depending on who tells the story.

Introducing the Beautiful Black Bean Burger! Yes, vegetarians, this week is all yours! A house-made black bean patty filled with onion, a blend of tasty spices and chipotle peppers layered with our own fresh guacamole, roasted corn and habanero aioli. Served on a yummy pretzel bun with a wispy bibb lettuce leaf.
